label: PF Backlog 201
title: Backend: two-phase model selection - post-architect MODEL & CAPABILITY strategy gate
body:
## Problem / why The model tier/models are chosen EARLY - at creation (config/model-tier.json active_tier) and the preflight `_run_model_fit_preflight()` runs at run start (pipeline_executor.py:2864) BEFORE any stage. At that point the idea's modality/complexity is unknown, so the model strategy cannot match the project. The real capability needs are only known AFTER discovery (0a) + design (1) + architect (1b). ## Goal & value TWO-PHASE model selection (progressive elaboration): - Phase A (creation -> run start): a PROVISIONAL tier - just enough to run 0a/1/1b. - Phase B (gate AFTER 1b architect): a MODEL & CAPABILITY STRATEGY pass that reads requirements + modality (0a) + tech stack/architecture (1b), enables the right capability packs (BI-0189), and chooses model types + tier per agent (vision/video/audio/generator vs text) via tier_builder/model_fit. - Phase C (stages 2..): run with the refined models + packs. ## In scope - A mid-pipeline strategy gate after the architect stage. - Persist a MODEL STRATEGY artifact (auditable/reproducible) + apply via model_router / per-agent override (BI-0178). - Modality-aware Phase A defaults where discovery itself needs media (else re-run that stage after the pack on). - Consume capability packs (BI-0189); reuse tier_builder + modality + model_fit. ## Out of scope - Generating the packs themselves (BI-0189); media agents (BI-0190). ## Acceptance criteria (testable) - Given a media idea, the strategy gate enables the media pack + selects modality-appropriate models before implementation. - Given a plain app idea, selection stays text/default. - The chosen strategy is persisted as an artifact and is what the run actually uses. ## Dependencies & links - epic BI-0185; capability packs BI-0189; override BI-0178; tier_builder (BI-0174); model_fit (BI-0076/0077). ## Open questions - Blocking gate (require approval) or auto (with override ability)? - If Phase A lacked a needed modality, auto re-run 0a/1/1b after enabling the pack? ## Verification / test plan - Run an app idea vs a media idea; assert differing model strategy + packs; artifact recorded. ## Added — from docs/multimodal_selection_dynamic.md - MODEL-STRATEGY artifact store: persist the chosen per-agent model types + tier (+ enabled packs) as `products/

/model-strategy.json` (single writer; register) so the run is auditable/reproducible. - DECISION POLICY: auto-with-override (default) vs blocking gate; record the decision. - MEDIA-BOOTSTRAP RE-RUN path: if Phase A lacked a needed modality (media arrived late), re-run 0a/1/1b after enabling the pack. - Guard: activate ONLY when `required_capabilities` is non-trivial (plain projects unchanged).

dashboard_impact.reason: Backend orchestration; surfaced via the dashboard later (agents window BI-0132).
